versions.content: ⌊ DRAFT g The Cross Cluster Communication of the Software Cluster Connection shall normalize the numerical values of attributes, before using them for the SwCluCBManifResourceGuardValue calculation, in such a way that compatible numerical values according to [TPS_GST_02501] result in the identical guard value.
